profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Software Architecture • Scalable APIs • Cloud Systems
profile.summary:
Senior Full Stack Engineer focused on backend architecture, scalable systems, and modern software design.
 
Throughout my career, I have worked on platforms, APIs, and internal tools focused on performance, automation, and maintainability, collaborating on key technical decisions and solution architecture.
 
Particularly interested in software architecture, distributed systems, clean code practices, and building products that can scale sustainably over time.
 
I enjoy environments where engineering has real technical ownership and where good design decisions create long-term impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Increased engineering productivity by incorporating LLM-assisted development workflows (Claude, Copilot) for code generation, debugging, technical research, and architectural problem-solving across distributed systems.
- Acted as technical lead and primary architect for the LMS Migration Tool, designing and implementing scalable services and data migration pipelines to ingest, transform, and migrate customer data from external LMS platforms into Mitratech systems.
- Developed and maintained scalable full stack enterprise applications using Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Express.js, SQL, AWS, and Terraform.
- Designed and deployed robust RESTful APIs with Express.js, enabling efficient management of critical customer and platform data.
- Investigated and resolved complex data corruption incidents affecting customer-facing systems, restoring historical data integrity and improving overall platform reliability.
- Optimized backend performance by refactoring JavaScript logic and SQL queries, significantly improving database operation speed and system responsiveness.
- Led modernization efforts by migrating core Golang services into modern JavaScript/TypeScript microservices, simplifying maintenance and improving development velocity.
- Worked with AWS cloud infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code tooling, and production deployment workflows using Terraform and Git-based CI/CD practices.
- Participated in technical discussions around system architecture, backend scalability, API design, and platform reliability for enterprise-scale applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed new full stack features using React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Express.js for enterprise-scale applications.
- Built and maintained backend APIs and frontend components, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
- Debugged and resolved frontend, backend, and data-related production issues, improving platform stability and user experience.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams on feature design, implementation, testing, and continuous platform improvements.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the design and implementation of a micro-frontend integration tool, standardizing integration patterns across teams and reducing resource usage.
- Designed and implemented Kafka-based event-driven flows across multiple product lines, enabling real-time data synchronization between services at scale.
- Refactored and optimized a core micro-frontend application used by thousands of users, improving load times and overall user experience.
- Developed scalable backend and frontend solutions using React, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Docker, and AWS across enterprise-level projects.
- Collaborated on architecture decisions, testing strategies, and platform reliability improvements, including monitoring integrations, CI/CD workflows, and frontend/backend test coverage enhancements.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained enterprise full stack applications using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, and Spring Boot within cybersecurity-focused platforms.
- Designed and implemented new product features, backend services, and frontend components for large-scale customer-facing systems.
- Debugged and resolved complex frontend, backend, and integration issues, improving platform stability and overall system reliability.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams on feature planning, technical design, testing, and continuous product improvements.
- Contributed to modernization and optimization efforts by improving application performance, maintainability, and development workflows.
positions.insights: Spring Boot, Go (Programming Language) and +6 skills

projects.title: ProfileMe
projects.description:
ProfileMe is an AI-assisted platform designed to help therapists and mental health professionals better organize and explore patient information through intelligent insights and conversational tools.

Built with Next.js, React, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, Supabase, and AI integrations, the platform allows therapists to securely review notes, track behavioral patterns, and interact with AI-generated summaries and recommendations while maintaining user-controlled data access.

Focused on scalable architecture, clean UI/UX, secure role-based access, and AI-powered workflows.

projects.title: Flappy Pokemon
projects.description: A simple neural network from scratch using React with Typescript and P5 with a Pokemon themed, you can choose the character sprite and the AI will learn how to play alone without human intervention, you can increase or decrease the learn velocity to make it quicker
